nodes.name: setup_logging.py
nodes.summary: Provides the setup_serve_logging() function called during FastAPI application startup to configure structured logging for the Ray Serve management API.

nodes.name: cai_cluster_manager.py
nodes.summary: Defines CAIClusterManager — the service class that orchestrates Ray cluster startup and teardown on Cloudera AI by launching head and worker CML applications and waiting for cluster readiness.

nodes.name: worker_node.py
nodes.summary: Defines data structures and logic for CML worker node lifecycle management, representing the node configuration and state transitions used by CAIClusterManager.

nodes.name: nginx_service.py
nodes.summary: Manages nginx process lifecycle for the reverse proxy that fronts the management API, including starting, stopping, and health-checking the nginx subprocess.
